free_tier.stated: The all-servers list opens at EUR 27.00 a month for a Dual Intel G6950 (2x2.8Ghz) with 4GB DDR3 and a 1x1TB SATA III. The Intel Xeon E-2186G (6x3.8GHz) with 32GB DDR4 and a 480GB SSD is EUR 89.99 and the Intel Xeon E3-1275 v6 (4x3.8GHz) with 16GB DDR4 and a 1x1TB SATA III is EUR 144.00. The GPU rows are a Dual Intel Xeon Silver 4110 (16x2.1GHz) 4-bay with an NVIDIA Tesla P40 24GB DDR5, 64GB DDR4, 1TB NVMe and 10 Gbps at EUR 1,003.00, and the same CPU with a Tesla V100 16GB HMB2 at EUR 1,259.00, both marked Contact Sales.
